# Floating Callout on Hover

Hover over the buttons below to see detailed information:


```{=html}

<!-- Container to manage layout -->
<div class="callout-flex-container">

  <!-- BUTTON 1 WRAPPER -->
  <div class="hover-callout-wrapper">
    <button class="callout-trigger">View Summary</button>
    
    <!-- THE FLOATING CALLOUT (Initially Hidden) -->
    <div class="floating-callout top-right">
      <h4>Quarterly Report</h4>
      <ul>
        <li>Revenue: +12%</li>
        <li>Users: +5k</li>
        <li>Churn: -2%</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- BUTTON 2 WRAPPER -->
  <div class="hover-callout-wrapper">
    <button class="callout-trigger alt">Check Status</button>
    
    <!-- THE FLOATING CALLOUT (Initially Hidden) -->
    <div class="floating-callout bottom-left">
      <h4>System Status</h4>
      <div class="status-indicator">
        <span class="dot green"></span> All systems operational
      </div>
      <p><small>Last check: 1 min ago</small></p>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
